Duplicate obligationsPASSH3-ORR1 and H3-ORR2 impose distinct preservation obligations for obstacle presence and braking-relevant spatial relation.
CompatibilityPASSThe two distinctions can be preserved simultaneously.
TraceabilityPASSEach ORR traces to a final CRD and visible source artefacts.
Orphan ORRsPASSNo ORR lacks an originating CRD.
Uncovered CRDsPASSNo identified final CRD lacks a corresponding ORR.
